title: Kutthroat Bill Vol. 1 Album Art
coreRelationships: Large red 'KTD' letters serve as the central, dominant graphic element.
A black bird with outstretched wings is centrally placed, partially obscuring the 'KTD' letters.
Two large knives are crossed behind the bird and 'KTD' letters, with their blades extending behind the letters and handles visible below.
The title text is positioned above the main graphic, creating a clear hierarchy.
The credit text is small and located at the bottom, providing a subtle but necessary detail.
reuseFormula: Recreate the dark background with the central, large, stylized red and metallic 'KTD' letters. Overlay a black bird with outstretched wings and two crossed knives behind the 'KTD'. Place the gothic-style red title 'KUTTHROAT BILL:' and white sans-serif 'VOL. 1' above, and the small white sans-serif credit text below.
